rows.comment: It’s accentuated that the monkey kills aimlessly––perhaps
rows.verdict_le10: It’s accentuated that the monkey kills aimlessly––perhaps
rows.dek_lead: It’s accentuated that the monkey kills aimlessly––perhaps, at turns, even spitefully––but never by decree. By the time the boys have grown up and Theo James is cartoonishly portraying both of them––one basically Velma and the other a mullet
